references.phrase: cocone morphisms F(i)→Q compatible with the diagram
references.context: Category theory: cocone from a diagram F to a constant object Q

references.phrase: unique factorization of each other cocone
references.context: Category theory: universal initial property among cocones from a fixed diagram

references.disposition: Quantification is over all compatible cocones, not merely all individual maps from one F(i).

review_rationale: Read the full cocone and unique mediating map property: F:I→C is a diagram, the maps F(i)→Q are compatible, and every other cocone factors uniquely through Q. Not an ordinary limit with arrows reversed.
